questions.scenario: Nginx accepts public HTTPS and forwards requests to an application on 127.0.0.1:9000. Which role is Nginx performing?
questions.explanation: Nginx receives client requests, can terminate TLS, and proxies them to an upstream application. [Nginx proxy module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html).

questions.scenario: Two server blocks listen on port 80. Requests for app.example.com hit the default block. What should be checked first?

options.text: The server_name values and the Host header

questions.explanation: Nginx selects a virtual server using listen and server-name processing before it selects a location. [Request processing](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/request_processing.html).

questions.scenario: Locations `/` and `/api/` both match `/api/orders`. Which ordinary prefix location is more specific?

options.text: The one written last always wins

questions.explanation: For prefix locations, Nginx remembers the longest matching prefix before applying regex-location rules. [Core location directive](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#location).

questions.scenario: A static SPA loads at `/`, but refreshing `/settings` returns 404. Which pattern preserves real files and adds a client-side routing fallback?
questions.explanation: `try_files` checks candidates in order and can internally redirect missing deep links to the SPA entry point. [try_files directive](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html#try_files).

questions.scenario: A `/api/` location must remove that prefix before sending `/orders` upstream. Which proxy target does that?
questions.explanation: When `proxy_pass` includes a URI, the normalized matching location portion is replaced by that URI. The trailing slash therefore matters. [proxy_pass directive](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_pass).

questions.scenario: An upstream must reconstruct the public request URL after TLS terminates at Nginx. Which two headers commonly preserve essential context?
questions.explanation: Forwarding the original host and scheme gives the application the public request context it may need for routing and URL generation. [proxy_set_header](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html#proxy_set_header).

questions.scenario: A production configuration file was edited. The current workers are still healthy. What should happen before reload?

options.text: Stop Nginx and delete the old file

questions.explanation: Testing catches syntax and supported configuration failures before asking the running service to adopt the candidate. [Nginx command-line parameters](https://nginx.org/en/docs/switches.html).

questions.scenario: Nginx returns 502 and its error log says connection refused while connecting to upstream. What should be checked next?

options.text: The upstream address, port, listener, and service health

questions.explanation: A refused upstream connection means the proxy reached the network boundary but no accepting service handled that tuple. Inspect the configured target and listener. [Nginx proxy module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html).

questions.scenario: An upstream pool has three servers, but one consistently fails health checks. Which two actions are appropriate?

options.text: Inspect per-upstream failures and remove or mark the unhealthy member while repairing it
Point every request at the failed member
Keep enough healthy capacity before changing the pool

questions.explanation: Use upstream-specific evidence and preserve capacity while isolating a failed member. Unrelated TLS weakening and concentrating traffic on the failure increase risk. [Nginx upstream module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html).

questions.scenario: Ordinary HTTP proxying works, but WebSocket upgrades fail. Which configuration area is specific to that protocol switch?

options.text: Forwarding Upgrade and Connection hop-by-hop headers with HTTP/1.1

questions.explanation: WebSocket proxying requires explicit handling of the protocol-upgrade headers because hop-by-hop headers are not forwarded automatically. [Nginx WebSocket proxying](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/websocket.html).
